hebrewText: שֵׁ֤שֶׁת יָמִים֙ תַּעֲשֶׂ֣ה מַעֲשֶׂ֔י/ךָ וּ/בַ/יּ֥וֹם הַ/שְּׁבִיעִ֖י תִּשְׁבֹּ֑ת לְמַ֣עַן יָנ֗וּחַ שֽׁוֹרְ/ךָ֙ וַ/חֲמֹרֶ֔/ךָ וְ/יִנָּפֵ֥שׁ בֶּן אֲמָתְ/ךָ֖ וְ/הַ/גֵּֽר

tokens.bdb: six (as an overplus  beyond five or the fingers of the hand); as ord. sixth
a day (as the warm hours), whether literal (from sunrise to sunset, or from one sunset to the next), or figurative (a space of time defined by an associated term), (often used adverb)

tokens.kjv: because of, to the end (intent) that, for (to,... 's sake), [phrase] lest, that, to.

tokens.bdb: to rest, i.e. settle down; used in a great variety of applications, literal and figurative, intransitive, transitive and causative (to dwell, stay, let fall, place, let alone, withdraw, give comfort, etc.)
tokens.kjv: cease, be confederate, lay, let down, (be) quiet, remain, (cause to, be at, give, have, make to) rest, set down. Compare H3241 (יָנִים).
bull(-ock), cow, ox, wall (by mistake for H7791 (שׁוּר)).

to breathe; passively, to be breathed upon , i.e. (figuratively) refreshed (as if by a current of air)
a son (as a builder of the family name), in the widest sense (of literal and figurative relationship, including grandson, subject, nation, quality or condition, etc., (like father or brother), etc.)
